ceiling_profile.source: Candidate longitudinal envelope from section_registration.json source-pixel ceiling picks; follows outer section outline, not a measured interior soffit. Display-only; transverse dome shape and wall outline unresolved.

interior_ceiling.source: Recessed oval traced on the HSR 1993 attic plan (p139): about 73 ft across the house and 51 ft along it (Beranek 1996 p159 section shows the cove chord nearer 60 ft along; 55 +/- 5 used via aspect 0.75), centre about 47 ft behind the proscenium wall on both drawings; rise about 5 ft from the Beranek section at 8 px/ft. Acoustic plaster per Beranek 1996 p160. Chandelier 25-27 ft (HSR 1993 / SFGATE). Scale uncertainty +/-7%. | Shared illustrative interior ceiling from Fable visual rebuild. Rear uses candidate section outline. Not a surveyed interior; dome uses bounded facets for first-order acoustic reflection only. | Carey & Co. Historic Structure Report 1993 (sources/research/hsr1993/HSR_1993_text.txt): the orchestra ceiling has a large recessed oval bounded by a gilded cornice, sunburst chandelier 27 ft in diameter (25 ft per SFGATE/SFCV); ceilings over the balconies flat plaster with recessed octagonal fixtures. No source gives the oval's diameter, depth or the ceiling height beyond Beranek H = 73 ft; dome_radius/rise remain illustrative.

side_wall_plan.source: HSR 1993 upper balcony plan (sources/research/hsr1993/HSR_p137_plan_balcony_upper.png) and attic plan (p139): the void between the side walls is about 57 ft wide at the proscenium wall, about 98 ft at 37 ft back and reaches the full breadth near 75 ft; scale 6.8-7.4 px/ft depending on the anchor (stage house 135 ft; house breadth 113 ft), so +/-4 ft. Tour photos 01 and 05 show the three organ-loft arch bays converging on the proscenium; the 1993 HSR and 1965 report describe the arches as balustrade, plaster screen and heavy curtains (unused organ lofts, converted to restrooms 1997). Applies above the box zone (bottom_y_ft); the walls at box and orchestra level near the stage are not yet traced. | 2026-09-12: orchestra plan p099 (origin x=1110 curtain line, y=1040 centreline, 6.83 px/ft) shows the orchestra-level walls also fanning from the proscenium corner: half-width 29 ft at z=0, 37 at 10, 40 at 20, 45 at 42, 51 at 72 ('lower'). Grand Tier (p115) and Dress Circle (p121) plans show the same splay above the boxes with the organ-loft chambers (rooms 233/234, 323/324) behind the splayed walls, so the arch bays open into deep chambers. Between 16 and 24 ft (box zone) the boundary is the box ring with its rear wall about 10 ft behind the rail (p107).
